KeyStory: He declared to Jehoshaphat and all Judah, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's — and told them they would not need to fight, but only stand and see the salvation of the LORD.
LifeLesson: God's word through one faithful voice steadied a whole nation. When the battle is bigger than you, stand still and watch what God does.
Name: Jahaziel, Son of Zechariah
RelatedPeople: Zechariah, Father of Jahaziel; King Jehoshaphat
Role: Levite of the Sons of Asaph
Summary: Jahaziel was a Levite of the sons of Asaph upon whom the Spirit of the LORD came in the midst of the congregation as Judah faced a vast invading army.
